item.title: openclaw 2026.10.5-beta.1
item.description:
2026.10.5-beta.1

Highlights

  • Safer updates: updates finish across devices, filesystems, Windows elevation, and interrupted activations, and recover from stale leases or changed evidence instead of stranding the install or blocking future updates. (#164636, #164769, #165257, #165863, #166548, #166695, #168043, #166394, #167302) Thanks @hrp6vv9mwr-glitch, @MrJanvar, @Shirleyyyhk, @farisoftfry, @neilofneils404, and @shanselman.
  • Restart-safe conversations: interrupted turns, first messages during worktree preparation, and deferred tasks resume after a Gateway restart, and user input and committed session data survive restarts, concurrent writes, and failed publications. (#165333, #166042, #165184, #166238, #165502, #167570, #163258, #166010, #167662) Thanks @masatohoshino, @goutamadwant, and @hawkit.
  • Faster, steadier Gateway: session, transcript, history, and metadata reads move onto worker threads with far less SQLite work per turn, and startup maintenance runs after readiness so busy Gateways stay responsive. (#164744, #165470, #165614, #166587, #167194, #164779, #165028, #166041, #167278, #165993) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Reliable turns and subagents: turns recover from stalled streams, reused tool-call IDs, and expired ChatGPT websockets, incomplete turns end with a visible notice, and subagent results keep returning through follow-ups, restarts, and expired delivery windows. (#165983, #167013, #165212, #167063, #167972, #164282, #168068, #166846, #166139, #165987) Thanks @cestercian, @Irish-Joseph, @rmyers64, @sszyh2026, @Jackten, @Oldrich333, @obviyus, @stackingrockss, @Yun-0000, @michaeljgood71, and @LifeViwer.
  • X channel: answer X (Twitter) mentions through a new channel plugin with streaming, guest mode for repository questions, and enforced API cost limits. (#165138, #165337, #165354, #165351)
  • Voice calls: voice calls gain per-call briefs, call reports, live steering, callbacks, and voicemail detection. (#165716) Thanks @mbelinky and @jacobtomlinson.
  • Smarter model pickers: pickers lead with each provider's recommended models, show newly listed Claude, ChatGPT, and Ollama models without waiting for an OpenClaw release, and stay responsive while catalogs load. (#167370, #166737, #167658, #167387, #167463, #165989) Thanks @obviyus, @DonnieFi, and @dprev.
  • ClawHub in the Gateway: browse and search ClawHub plugins and skills from the Gateway, and plugins automatically pick the newest official release your OpenClaw supports. (#163459, #167485, #166588) Thanks @jacobtomlinson and @charlesBerg-ux.

Changes

  • Sessions: allow directed sends to a session without granting transcript access. (#164444)
  • Worker-local inference: add a native worker inference runtime with Gateway dispatch, client placement, required worker policy and destination checks before local inference, and clear setup-failure explanations. (#158902, #163645, #163646, #163647, #166611, #166613, #165960) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Public threads: open public threads at their regular links. (#166049)
  • Subagent progress: count running subagents on the working line, name launched subagents in the operations group, and continue a resumed answer in the block that handed off. (#165477, #165725, #165542) Thanks @shakkernerd.
  • X channel: add the X (Twitter) mentions channel plugin with Activity API streaming and backfill, repository-question guest mode with hidden same-agent helpers, GitHub-verified repository writers, and daily and monthly X API cost limits. (#165138, #165337, #165376, #165354, #165543, #168071, #165351) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Automation repair: let a failing automation's owner conversation repair it before alerting, give a second repair turn when the error changes, and post a clear warning when a repair turn times out. (#161007, #162702, #162772) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Channel progress: show useful Telegram and Discord progress by default, add per-tool glyphs to Discord progress drafts, restore per-tool emoji on Telegram tool rows, and hide routine Slack reaction rows. (#166861, #168032, #167392, #166880) Thanks @obviyus, @keshavbotagent, and @notmnp.
  • Skills: keep learned skills focused on repeatable procedures rather than facts or codebase knowledge, and keep longer legacy Workshop skills manageable. (#167404, #167639) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Memory: explain why trigger recall is skipped and why embedding responses are rejected, and report managed Ollama and LM Studio embedding readiness. (#164409, #168035, #156483) Thanks @Ayushdevo, @wangmiao0668000666, and @obviyus.
  • Models and catalogs: show each provider's recommended models first in pickers, publish curated per-provider recommendations in catalog v2, lead NVIDIA recommendations with its featured models, and apply downloaded catalogs without a Gateway restart. (#167370, #166737, #167989, #158000) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Anthropic and Claude CLI: support Claude Haiku 5.5, show newly listed Claude models without waiting for an OpenClaw release, list each Claude CLI model once, and keep logged-out Claude CLI models listed with a login reason. (#166706, #167658, #166311, #166338, #167942) Thanks @RomneyDa and @obviyus.
  • OpenAI: support custom realtime voice endpoints, show account chat models missing from the manifest, surface new ChatGPT-login models without a release, and stop offering ChatGPT-only or bundled-Codex-rejected models that would fail. (#165632, #162563, #167387, #167633, #167975) Thanks @jacobtomlinson and @obviyus.
  • Tool rows and subagent progress: show Tool Search calls in native tool rows with shared tool icons across clients, show the subagent wait in place without handoff markers, and guide users after HTTP 400 prompt-size rejections. (#165095, #165378, #159712) Thanks @shakkernerd and @sunlit-deng.
  • Voice calls: add per-call briefs, call reports, live steering, callbacks, and voicemail detection to voice calls. (#165716) Thanks @mbelinky and @jacobtomlinson.
  • Control UI subagents: show when a chat is waiting on subagents, open the Subagents panel from the chat's subagent count and names, and surface child failures and attention in the parent chat. (#164190, #166142, #166224, #166312, #166347) Thanks @shakkernerd and @vincentkoc.
  • Control UI customization: let themes customize Control UI branding, use agent avatars or unlocked Lobsterdex icons for browser tabs, choose favicon shapes, and add seven Lobsterdex character variants. (#168027, #165201, #166325, #167809, #159815) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski, @jacobtomlinson, and @hannesrudolph.
  • Terminal: add configurable terminal fonts with built-in Nerd Font icons. (#166180) Thanks @jacobtomlinson.
  • Control UI navigation: copy file paths from chat tooltips, pin agents directly from the switcher, make agent menus easier to scan, let users hide a session's branch PR row, and simplify optional question cards. (#164431, #165640, #165641, #166366, #168040, #150587) Thanks @jjjhenriksen, @vyctorbrzezowski, and @RomneyDa.
  • Skill Workshop: show each skill with its changes, files, and history in one view. (#167440) Thanks @obviyus.
  • iOS: connect the Gateway through native Cloudflare Access with app-owned browser and profile admission. (#147244, #147238) Thanks @vincentkoc, @Solvely-Colin, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @RomneyDa.
  • ClawHub: browse and search ClawHub plugins and skills through the Gateway. (#163459) Thanks @jacobtomlinson.
  • Plugins: let plugin tools deliver their finished reply without a second model turn, allow every loaded plugin its own state and ingress queues and queue modes, and select plugin-owned self-hosted executors. (#164558, #165063, #165965, #161609) Thanks @mbelinky and @sjf-oa.
  • Plugins: pick the newest official plugin release the running OpenClaw supports and keep a working plugin when its matching release is unavailable. (#167485, #166588) Thanks @charlesBerg-ux.
  • Workboard: pin, unpin, and delete boards from the sidebar, keep card notes selectable with a roomier notes editor, and keep column edits on rename. (#165020, #166625, #167348) Thanks @rogeriochaves, @llmsommelier, and @obviyus.
  • GitHub: support asynchronous PR merges and compact the Publish PR card. (#163579, #165219) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Session performance: serve per-turn session projections, entry reads, authority checks, compaction reads, and first-turn headers from worker threads to keep the Gateway main thread responsive. (#164779, #165028, #165205, #165406, #165401, #165581, #165819, #165027, #165367, #164747, #164989, #165073)
  • Session list and search performance: stop Control UI list refresh bursts, bound list materialization, scope and prefilter transcript search, speed up cold suggestion lists, and retain previews across metadata edits. (#162280, #164764, #165080, #165089, #165570, #165150, #165834, #165096, #165932, #166635, #165887, #167909)
  • Turn database performance: reduce SQLite statements, worker requests, and redundant reads per chat turn, batch snapshot and metadata queries, and reuse admitted schema and reader facts. (#164490, #166041, #166053, #166054, #166074, #166102, #166541, #166503, #166519, #166698, #167278, #167686, #167685, #167690, #167932, #167046, #166966, #166925, #167291, #166703, #167029, #165360, #165193)
  • State database performance: speed up cold agent database admission and crash recovery, reuse integrity checks on clean restarts, stop reopening executors when switching agents, and release leases promptly during shutdown. (#164846, #165070, #165186, #165293, #165680, #166112, #165993, #167001, #168008, #164788, #164962, #165085, #165910, #166822)
  • Maintenance and history performance: lighten idle and manual maintenance, lifecycle cleanup, archive, reset, and trajectory retention work, and speed history reads with nested tool activity. (#164851, #164755, #164938, #165081, #165082, #165254, #165090, #165074, #165274, #165678, #167268, #167070, #167549, #167643, #168013, #167449, #165221, #165181, #165093, #165086, #165111, #165377, #165495, #165909, #166069, #166631, #166778, #166804, #167434, #167915, #167959) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen and @obviyus.
  • Agent performance: reduce retained heap, per-turn prompt allocations, transcript reads, and main-thread SQLite work during runs, preserve prompt cache across instruction refreshes and image cleanup, and reuse verified history images across turns. (#167454, #167922, #167682, #167547, #167698, #167613, #167355, #167938, #165142, #165404, #167282, #164685, #165012, #165410, #165370, #165552) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Model catalog performance: speed up multi-provider catalog refreshes, avoid discovery on cold account reads and unrequested plugin catalogs, retain account catalogs during refresh, and reduce catalog worker heap. (#167101, #167334, #167359, #167009, #167008, #166007, #166434, #165911, #165708, #165547, #165034, #165491, #166602) Thanks @vincentkoc, @obviyus, and @xialonglee.
  • Subagent and ACP performance: reduce startup registry restore latency, move bulk registry work off the Gateway thread, batch registry cohorts, and avoid full-session scans when resuming ACP sessions. (#165942, #165684, #165098, #167684, #167010, #167372, #165550, #167086)

Fixes

  • Session data safety: preserve user input and committed facts through restart recovery and failed publication, keep accepted locked appends settled before releasing the writer, and fence cross-store worker commits. (#165502, #167570, #165894, #168018, #168029)
  • Session authority and privacy: check caller authority before restoring cold history for compaction, keep authority current after committed session changes, reject malformed hook session keys, and hide pre-session edits to branch-added files from uncommitted diffs. (#166506, #167875, #166406, #164671) Thanks @yetval and @obviyus.
  • Session cleanup: remove leftover GitHub publication receipts and managed worktrees on cleanup and Incognito reset, and publish conversation, plugin-state, sandbox, worktree, and GitHub authority receipts. (#163833, #165185, #167731, #168025) Thanks @jayzhou2309 and @obviyus.
  • Turn reliability: recover agent turns when the database worker exits mid-operation, stop unrelated session writes from failing Codex and chat turns, keep Knowledge calls working while a session publishes its bookkeeping, and stop group turns from failing silently when history cannot load. (#163258, #165196, #166010, #166758, #135253, #166059) Thanks @goutamadwant, @hawkit, @jalehman, and @izshaw.
  • Restart recovery: settle sessions left running after restart, avoid duplicate recovery after ordinary interruptions, keep recovery reconciliation on the host, and preserve database admission, custody, and hook retries for post-restart and first-session turns. (#165174, #154175, #166395, #166867, #166609, #167629, #165859, #165738, #166891) Thanks @Grynn and @RomneyDa.
  • Agent and session creation: fix concurrent first requests for a new agent, cold shared-store and fresh-store creation failures, and agent database recovery after orphan session window repair. (#166003, #167257, #167515, #167366, #166860)
  • Windows and path aliases: canonicalize the shared state database path and compare link-stable identities so Windows and POSIX path aliases share one store, custody, and channel lifecycle. (#166755, #165775, #166062, #166462, #166787) Thanks @taihartman, @donquiche61, @RomneyDa, and @ericcaiwx-star.
  • SQLite deadlocks and stalls: prevent writer-reader admission and cleanup deadlocks, keep committed reads responsive during writer stalls, stop writer-held transcript reads waiting on readers, and keep foreign changes visible during refresh. (#167662, #167446, #167901, #167687, #166331, #165898, #167332) Thanks @sasan1200 and @vincentkoc.
  • State and updates: stop leftover update-check caches and completed recovery history from blocking updates, and give one actionable answer for state written by a newer release while keeping status reads read-only. (#165461, #167358, #166963) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Startup and integrity checks: return pending admission during startup index repair, retain integrity proof through startup and idle retirement, stop early lease timers on long delays, avoid false state ownership loss on Bun, and stop healthy starts logging SQLite lock-wait warnings. (#165323, #166972, #166412, #167467, #167669, #167754, #166253, #168310) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Session search and history: search transcripts for configured ACP owners, stop false indexing notices, keep search parallel with accurate indexing, preserve dot-prefixed checkpoint references and CLI history after interrupted progress replies, and keep canonical transcript owners distinct. (#164897, #165879, #167174, #167163, #164920, #166658, #164512) Thanks @sunlit-deng, @obviyus, @techdou, @shakkernerd, and @VACInc.
  • Session display: stop Markdown link markup leaking into previews, show correct context windows for plugin-discovered models, log failed wakes with their target, keep owning agents in lifecycle commands and trajectory export, and decode UTF-16 BOM text files. (#166653, #159731, #166458, #166415, #165777) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @obviyus, @rudycelekli, @Yigtwxx, and @yetval.
  • Startup ordering: stop agents with small transcript rebuild backlogs from waiting behind larger agents at startup. (#165207)
  • Security boundaries: fail closed on unresolved A2A peer token references and when the process census cannot prove a temp root is unused, and reject incompatible worker prompt contexts before launch. (#165021, #165079, #166268) Thanks @eleqtrizit, @Dhotei, @vincentkoc, and @obviyus.
  • Data integrity: reject malformed UTF-8 backup manifests before verification, preserve malformed UTF-8 and trailing-space connect targets, and keep accents in named legacy text attachments. (#167389, #167399, #167116, #165405) Thanks @Alix-007, @obviyus, and @Chessing234.
  • Restart recovery: resume Control UI turns interrupted by a Gateway restart, keep a new session's first message when the Gateway restarts during worktree preparation, resume tasks after deferred startup recovery, pause restart recovery while the crash-loop breaker is tripped, and settle restart intents and update reports in workers. (#165333, #166042, #165184, #166238, #167572, #165069, #165670) Thanks @masatohoshino.
  • Turn lifecycle: publish one terminal event per stopped or runtime-lost run, settle terminal runs before session mutations, keep queued message run ids and replies aligned, and prevent internal recovery errors after queued turns. (#165483, #167383, #166784, #166981, #165996, #164656) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Stop and steering: stop yielded commands with their Gateway request, retire stopped continuations, allow wakes after stopped commands, preserve running tools when steering receipts are uncertain, show accepted steering messages in order, and hold steering during worktree creation until the task finishes. (#166753, #166775, #166968, #166754, #168099, #165462, #165537) Thanks @shakkernerd and @RomneyDa.
  • Queue fairness: prevent background starvation under sustained traffic, avoid stalled turns when diagnostics throw, keep permit waiters until their real deadline, and cancel queued host callbacks at task deadlines. (#167683, #167733, #165359, #167740) Thanks @Chessing234.
  • Chat delivery: deliver activity-summary updates after compaction, hide managed media directives in CR-only replies, keep node completion follow-ups in their originating conversation, preserve live node approval handoffs, and stop false Yield failed warnings in group chats. (#165024, #164657, #160675, #166971, #161154, #166396) Thanks @ly85206559, @obviyus, and @brokemac79.
  • Session creation: keep new sessions working while other local turns start or finish, recognize agents immediately after agents.create, keep parent-only sessions bound to their agent, and bind required worker sessions during workspace binding. (#165984, #167894, #165929, #167162) Thanks @alkor2000, @markstones78, and @RomneyDa.
  • Chat history: stop endless retries for sessions in skipped agent stores, return anchored history for pre-reset Claude CLI-bound messages, retain tool history details and channel startup context, and keep generated and truncated session titles UTF-16 safe and balanced. (#165408, #166578, #164848, #141240, #167584) Thanks @obviyus, @VACInc, @sjf-oa, @sjf, @hugenshen, and @cursoragent.
  • Claude CLI and helper calls: keep claude-cli session tools and later CLI bridge calls working after the starting turn ends, route shorthand Anthropic CLI auth refs correctly, keep the session observer working on CLI-backed utility models, and keep OpenClaw helper calls working across runtime changes. (#165432, #165428, #84374, #162067, #166235) Thanks @Oldrich333, @Leit-motif, @nano-richtera, @joshavant, @obviyus, @rogeriochaves, @llmsommelier, and @PollyBot13.
  • Models and catalog: keep Codex selectable after startup and deferred agent startup, recheck models after failed catalog recovery, stop catalog continuations hanging while models load, and keep OpenRouter and LM Studio thinking levels intact. (#165979, #166081, #162901, #166089, #166705, #164478, #164597) Thanks @scotthuang, @ericcaiwx-star, @obviyus, @ooiuuii, and @VACInc.
  • Usage and metrics: report usage for silent replies, estimate context when compatible streams omit usage, include background utility completions in token and cost metrics, and keep usage ranges ordered when the host skipped a date. (#152396, #166151, #167986, #165523, #164140) Thanks @ly85206559, @obviyus, @MutenCath, @fede-kamel, @ericcurtin, @etzelm, @SashaMIT, and @DasX.
  • Startup and readiness: show startup failures even when cleanup fails, stop small agents waiting on larger agents, prevent public chat 503s and stalls after startup, avoid failures during temporary state contention, and stop Gateway start reporting success before an existing process is ready. (#164500, #165107, #167604, #167544, #166111, #166942, #167697, #167674) Thanks @sunlit-deng, @obviyus, @waynegault, @NianJiuZst, @ericcaiwx-star, @mashaohua1999-stack, and @RomneyDa.
  • Plugins and restarts: stop treating restarts as plugin removal, retry stuck plugin reloads once their work settles, keep Control UI reconnects from freezing the Gateway during plugin reloads, and ship hidden external plugin chunks to cloud workers. (#164975, #164894, #167374, #165669) Thanks @obviyus, @jalehman, @LiuwqGit, and @JakeBotFleet.
  • Status and diagnostics: stop deep status blaming config for an unreadable state database, report startup migrations and channel logouts accurately, surface startup failures over unrelated log lines, use plain language for diagnostic checks, stop recommending onboarding for runtime failures, and report signal-terminated node commands. (#167352, #167723, #167478, #166946, #165742, #166234, #165116, #165358, #165426) Thanks @RomneyDa, @PollyBot13, @obviyus, @Colton-Harris, and @shakkernerd.
  • Daemon and platforms: recover disabled Windows Gateway tasks from Doctor, restore gateway stop, restart, and update on macOS 12, avoid versioned pnpm launcher paths, keep exec and MCP servers working after a Homebrew Node upgrade, and reconnect Apple clients promptly after network changes. (#164728, #163317, #167905, #166222, #166430, #168024) Thanks @NovaUnboundAi, @xXG0DLessXx, @RomneyDa, @SMF12138, @jayzhou2309, and @mightyx.
  • Networking: restore managed portals on large Tailscale tailnets, keep verified Tailscale GitHub users signed in during GitHub rate limits, stop interrupted Tailscale serve processes, emit TLS key identifiers for strict egress proxy clients, recover proxy requests instead of one-token replies, and bound unattributable proxy warnings. (#165507, #166254, #167514, #165818, #167878, #134404) Thanks @obviyus, @redasadki, @pandysp, @vortexopenclaw, @RyanSandoval, @jacobtomlinson, @amittell, @lzhan011, and @abacha.
  • Workers and processes: stop repeated worker starts after initialization failure, keep workspace recovery running during unrelated writes, stop background execs outliving cleanup, load source workspace workers from external directories, release settled work blocking suspension, and avoid heap-check stalls in busy Bun Gateways. (#165277, #166375, #166478, #166606, #165871, #167184, #166104, #166608, #162124) Thanks @Oldrich333, @RomneyDa, @michaelswissa, and @obviyus.
  • Gateway behavior: encode Ctrl+Space and modified function keys in send-keys, collapse finished processes by default, cap oversized policy watch intervals, keep slow WebSocket response logs and stop listener buildup, keep OpenAI-compatible cancellations from blaming the provider, and explain protected credential execution limits. (#164688, #164776, #164850, #164772, #165052, #167995, #167976) Thanks @yetval, @obviyus, @shakkernerd, @KrasimirKralev, @etzelm, and @RomneyDa.
  • Integrations: parse Firecrawl source-specific results, report ComfyUI workflows without outputs, validate meeting timeouts, stop Mattermost retrying permanent refusals, and include jobId in agent_end hook context for scheduled runs. (#155885, #166249, #158695, #167244, #167124, #158632) Thanks @qingminglong, @obviyus, @chelsealong, @catnipluss, @Alix-007, @Leon-SK668, @xyrolle, and @masatohoshino.
  • Workspaces: reconcile root node workspaces and surface failures, reject timed-out workspace inventory commands, keep dashboard title work from blocking session rollover, and allow Claw removal with a running Gateway. (#166441, #167673, #162689, #166889) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star, @cursoragent, @obviyus, and @dimonnld.
  • Session reads: keep chat admission responsive and bound to current authority, refresh placement reads after concurrent publication, skip agent stores no configured agent owns, isolate session-worker receipts, and avoid an unavailable flash when refreshing conversations. (#164682, #165166, #164929, #165904, #167097, #167689, #165468) Thanks @galiniliev and @jacobtomlinson.
  • Agent CLI and recovery: keep withdrawal results when queued turns time out, report queued cancellation details, await system-agent audit and greeting persistence, record retired state deferred to Doctor, and keep Doctor maintenance working under the shared lease policy. (#167106, #166185, #165561, #165528, #164697, #165479) Thanks @A1fred-AI and @shakkernerd.
  • Channel security: stop removed X allowlist senders from reaching dispatch mid-authorization, redact credentials in Discord PluralKit, LINE, and Tlon API error bodies, bound pending IRC inbound lines, and reject unsafe LINE question option indexes and unmatchable Matrix auto-join entries. (#165244, #141317, #167234, #165018, #158694, #161607) Thanks @hugenshen, @obviyus, @xialonglee, @eleqtrizit, @Alix-007, @xydigitLybnnnn, and @captain-marlow.
  • Browser safety: isolate session tab ownership by agent, reject malformed JSON before filling forms, match URL globs without backtracking regexes, honor explicit management timeouts, and evict least recently used tabs at the managed tab cap. (#167484, #167412, #166727, #167252, #166666) Thanks @Alix-007, @obviyus, @SebTardif, @Leon-SK668, and @ruel225.
  • Reply delivery: stop reporting transcript-only channel replies as sent, deliver isolated cron results to their creating conversation, keep node completion and background command results in their own conversation, and stop repeated browser replies after background child work. (#164860, #167363, #164719, #166362) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @obviyus, @Jackten, @SparcleAI, and @shakkernerd.

item.content:encoded:
2026.10.5-beta.1

Highlights

  • Safer updates: updates finish across devices, filesystems, Windows elevation, and interrupted activations, and recover from stale leases or changed evidence instead of stranding the install or blocking future updates. (#164636, #164769, #165257, #165863, #166548, #166695, #168043, #166394, #167302) Thanks @hrp6vv9mwr-glitch, @MrJanvar, @Shirleyyyhk, @farisoftfry, @neilofneils404, and @shanselman.
  • Restart-safe conversations: interrupted turns, first messages during worktree preparation, and deferred tasks resume after a Gateway restart, and user input and committed session data survive restarts, concurrent writes, and failed publications. (#165333, #166042, #165184, #166238, #165502, #167570, #163258, #166010, #167662) Thanks @masatohoshino, @goutamadwant, and @hawkit.
  • Faster, steadier Gateway: session, transcript, history, and metadata reads move onto worker threads with far less SQLite work per turn, and startup maintenance runs after readiness so busy Gateways stay responsive. (#164744, #165470, #165614, #166587, #167194, #164779, #165028, #166041, #167278, #165993) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Reliable turns and subagents: turns recover from stalled streams, reused tool-call IDs, and expired ChatGPT websockets, incomplete turns end with a visible notice, and subagent results keep returning through follow-ups, restarts, and expired delivery windows. (#165983, #167013, #165212, #167063, #167972, #164282, #168068, #166846, #166139, #165987) Thanks @cestercian, @Irish-Joseph, @rmyers64, @sszyh2026, @Jackten, @Oldrich333, @obviyus, @stackingrockss, @Yun-0000, @michaeljgood71, and @LifeViwer.
  • X channel: answer X (Twitter) mentions through a new channel plugin with streaming, guest mode for repository questions, and enforced API cost limits. (#165138, #165337, #165354, #165351)
  • Voice calls: voice calls gain per-call briefs, call reports, live steering, callbacks, and voicemail detection. (#165716) Thanks @mbelinky and @jacobtomlinson.
  • Smarter model pickers: pickers lead with each provider's recommended models, show newly listed Claude, ChatGPT, and Ollama models without waiting for an OpenClaw release, and stay responsive while catalogs load. (#167370, #166737, #167658, #167387, #167463, #165989) Thanks @obviyus, @DonnieFi, and @dprev.
  • ClawHub in the Gateway: browse and search ClawHub plugins and skills from the Gateway, and plugins automatically pick the newest official release your OpenClaw supports. (#163459, #167485, #166588) Thanks @jacobtomlinson and @charlesBerg-ux.

Changes

  • Sessions: allow directed sends to a session without granting transcript access. (#164444)
  • Worker-local inference: add a native worker inference runtime with Gateway dispatch, client placement, required worker policy and destination checks before local inference, and clear setup-failure explanations. (#158902, #163645, #163646, #163647, #166611, #166613, #165960) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Public threads: open public threads at their regular links. (#166049)
  • Subagent progress: count running subagents on the working line, name launched subagents in the operations group, and continue a resumed answer in the block that handed off. (#165477, #165725, #165542) Thanks @shakkernerd.
  • X channel: add the X (Twitter) mentions channel plugin with Activity API streaming and backfill, repository-question guest mode with hidden same-agent helpers, GitHub-verified repository writers, and daily and monthly X API cost limits. (#165138, #165337, #165376, #165354, #165543, #168071, #165351) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Automation repair: let a failing automation's owner conversation repair it before alerting, give a second repair turn when the error changes, and post a clear warning when a repair turn times out. (#161007, #162702, #162772) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Channel progress: show useful Telegram and Discord progress by default, add per-tool glyphs to Discord progress drafts, restore per-tool emoji on Telegram tool rows, and hide routine Slack reaction rows. (#166861, #168032, #167392, #166880) Thanks @obviyus, @keshavbotagent, and @notmnp.
  • Skills: keep learned skills focused on repeatable procedures rather than facts or codebase knowledge, and keep longer legacy Workshop skills manageable. (#167404, #167639) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Memory: explain why trigger recall is skipped and why embedding responses are rejected, and report managed Ollama and LM Studio embedding readiness. (#164409, #168035, #156483) Thanks @Ayushdevo, @wangmiao0668000666, and @obviyus.
  • Models and catalogs: show each provider's recommended models first in pickers, publish curated per-provider recommendations in catalog v2, lead NVIDIA recommendations with its featured models, and apply downloaded catalogs without a Gateway restart. (#167370, #166737, #167989, #158000) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Anthropic and Claude CLI: support Claude Haiku 5.5, show newly listed Claude models without waiting for an OpenClaw release, list each Claude CLI model once, and keep logged-out Claude CLI models listed with a login reason. (#166706, #167658, #166311, #166338, #167942) Thanks @RomneyDa and @obviyus.
  • OpenAI: support custom realtime voice endpoints, show account chat models missing from the manifest, surface new ChatGPT-login models without a release, and stop offering ChatGPT-only or bundled-Codex-rejected models that would fail. (#165632, #162563, #167387, #167633, #167975) Thanks @jacobtomlinson and @obviyus.
  • Tool rows and subagent progress: show Tool Search calls in native tool rows with shared tool icons across clients, show the subagent wait in place without handoff markers, and guide users after HTTP 400 prompt-size rejections. (#165095, #165378, #159712) Thanks @shakkernerd and @sunlit-deng.
  • Voice calls: add per-call briefs, call reports, live steering, callbacks, and voicemail detection to voice calls. (#165716) Thanks @mbelinky and @jacobtomlinson.
  • Control UI subagents: show when a chat is waiting on subagents, open the Subagents panel from the chat's subagent count and names, and surface child failures and attention in the parent chat. (#164190, #166142, #166224, #166312, #166347) Thanks @shakkernerd and @vincentkoc.
  • Control UI customization: let themes customize Control UI branding, use agent avatars or unlocked Lobsterdex icons for browser tabs, choose favicon shapes, and add seven Lobsterdex character variants. (#168027, #165201, #166325, #167809, #159815) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski, @jacobtomlinson, and @hannesrudolph.
  • Terminal: add configurable terminal fonts with built-in Nerd Font icons. (#166180) Thanks @jacobtomlinson.
  • Control UI navigation: copy file paths from chat tooltips, pin agents directly from the switcher, make agent menus easier to scan, let users hide a session's branch PR row, and simplify optional question cards. (#166751, #166687, #165923, #167516, #166955, #166278, #165029, #159448, #165658, #165644, #166936, #167024, #166183, #164992, #166283, #167239, #167308) Thanks @jjjhenriksen, @RomneyDa, and @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • CLI and diagnostics performance: speed up gateway call cold starts, reuse prepared runtime inputs, speed up secret redaction for large text, calibrate memory pressure to runtime limits, and reduce Prometheus scrape allocation. (#166722, #166657, #166864, #162313, #166701, #167943, #165042, #167618, #167930, #166933, #165327) Thanks @sunlit-deng, @obviyus, and @etzelm.

item.title: openclaw 2026.10.1-beta.2
item.description:
2026.10.1-beta.2

Changes since 2026.10.1-beta.1, the previous npm beta-channel version. This is a hotfix beta covering 40 intervening commits, not a repeat of the cumulative October notes.

Highlights

  • Updates and Doctor: recover archive migrations and interrupted updates without leaving managed Gateways stopped, and restore Gateway lifecycle commands on macOS 12 and disabled Windows tasks. (#165854, #164636, #164849, #163317, #164728) Thanks @RomneyDa, @Olli0103, @hrp6vv9mwr-glitch, @szef-svg, @izrl613, @NovaUnboundAi, and @xXG0DLessXx.
  • Replies and messaging: preserve completed answers after silent follow-ups, let Discord corrections pass deferred messages, and restore Telegram sends and buttons after channel-routed handoffs. (#164774, #164896, #159265, #165137) Thanks @obviyus, @aatreya, and @mbelinky.
  • Plugins and cloud workers: keep plugin skills available during checkout updates, avoid slow native-prebuild scans, and include required external-plugin runtime chunks in cloud-worker bootstrap. (#165882, #165301, #165669) Thanks @RomneyDa, @goutamadwant, @exGeni, @LiuwqGit, and @JakeBotFleet.

Changes

No new capabilities; this beta focuses on fixes and recovery.

Fixes

  • Agent-to-agent authentication: reject unresolved peer-token references and report actionable peer-status warnings instead of continuing with an unusable credential. (#165021) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
  • Command execution: reject NUL-containing command arguments before starting helpers or replacing an existing run, avoiding later shutdown failures from malformed commands. (#164770) Thanks @shakkernerd.
  • Update recovery: avoid launcher-ownership failures in non-root updates, settle pending recovery after lease-database replacement, and keep archive recovery from stranding a stopped Gateway. (#164636, #164849, #165854) Thanks @hrp6vv9mwr-glitch, @szef-svg, @izrl613, @RomneyDa, and @Olli0103.
  • Doctor and migrations: import sessions from older completed migration receipts while retaining current sessions, verify snapshots on Linux hosts without file birthtime, and skip empty migration scans on unconfigured Matrix installations. (#164867, #164363, #165209) Thanks @hshs38033-cmd, @jayzhou2309, and @StevenKrebs.
  • Managed services: restore stop, restart, and update commands on macOS 12 Monterey, and let Doctor recover disabled Windows Gateway tasks while status identifies the disabled task. (#163317, #164728) Thanks @NovaUnboundAi, @xXG0DLessXx, and @RomneyDa.
  • Updater compatibility: complete the published October-beta cleanup path and retain loadable checkout-plugin skills during updates. (#165855, #165882) Thanks @shakkernerd and @RomneyDa.
  • Control UI: keep bundled UI assets readable under arbitrary container UIDs instead of returning HTTP 503. (#165880) Thanks @RomneyDa and @Conan-Scott.
  • Channel handoffs: restore Telegram sends and inline buttons after routed chat handoffs, and let newer Discord messages steer active work while an earlier message is deferred. (#165137, #159265) Thanks @mbelinky and @aatreya.
  • Agent replies: keep completed answers when a follow-up produces no reply, and preserve answers that already explain an approval or input blocker. (#164774, #164896) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Memory and turns: avoid session-indexing locks on rollback-journal databases and recover a turn when its database worker exits before an operation is dispatched. (#164624, #163258) Thanks @triciah73, @goutamadwant, and @hawkit.
  • Codex interruptions: preserve the shared client after a confirmed interruption so the replacement turn need not wait for unrelated active chats. (#165487)
  • Gateway tools and plugins: keep CLI bridge calls usable after the creating turn completes, and preserve plugin session state through Gateway restarts. (#165428, #164975) Thanks @nano-richtera.
  • Plugin loading and workers: avoid repeated native-prebuild scans and include hidden runtime chunks required by external plugins when dispatching cloud workers. (#165301, #165669) Thanks @goutamadwant, @exGeni, @LiuwqGit, and @JakeBotFleet.
  • Code Mode: improve tool-call schema compatibility by using the unambiguous awaitResults argument. (#165022)

Upgrading from an already-blocked older updater: these fixes do not patch the CLI already installed on your machine. If its preflight refuses the upgrade, install the new CLI manually before rerunning Doctor.

Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.1-beta.1..c58cf3afa0793257a8127ae868d5e159da6d9d0a history: 26 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 26 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

Shipped baseline exclusions: v2026.10.1-beta.1 (1 PRs: #157615).

item.title: openclaw 2026.10.1-beta.1
item.description:
2026.10.1-beta.1

Changes since 2026.9.8, the version selected by the npm beta channel before this release. Already-shipped contributions from that stable release are excluded from the record below.

Highlights

  • Code Mode can keep small session-scoped values across cells, replies, and Gateway restarts with store and load (#164086).
  • Control UI adds click-to-play YouTube cards, nested Workboards in the sidebar, and automatic pinning for boards you create (#164576, #164604).
  • Import readable coding-agent transcripts into durable OpenClaw sessions, with private drafts by default and incremental reimport (#161955).
  • Configure off-machine backups to external disks, NAS storage, or Cloudflare R2, with visible backup health and results (#161913).
  • Automations can check conditions without a model run, call explicitly allowed MCP servers, and expose cross-job history and inventory search (#101195, #160995, #148947, #150097) Thanks @obviyus and @Alix-007.
  • Installed-skill search and reading make admitted skills discoverable even when their instructions do not fit the initial prompt budget (#158089, #158090, #158091, #160538) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Selected memory plugins can own their pre-compaction flush, preserving memory through their own persistence tools (#162177) Thanks @jalehman.
  • Cloud-worker preparation supports configured GitHub Enterprise hosts for repository discovery and prepared workflows (#160108) Thanks @galiniliev.

Changes

  • Code Mode persistence is scoped to interactive sessions, limited to 256 KiB per value and 1 MiB per session; failed cells do not commit their pending writes (#164086).
  • MCP Apps can request permission to call a specific tool while their view remains open. The grant is tied to that view and requester, expires after ten minutes or view closure, and is not a persistent model-tool allowlist (#164496).
  • YouTube cards retain a watch-link fallback; sandboxed chat views remain link-only (#164576).
  • Transcript import supports readable Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, and OpenClaw catalogs through the CLI and Control UI. Reimport appends new items, and incomplete or bounded history reads are reported (#161955).
  • Backup storage locations require configuration and explicit initialization; scheduled backups can target external disks/NAS or Cloudflare R2. Client-side encryption is available, with an explicit operator option to disable it (#161913).
  • Installed-skill search covers names, descriptions, and instruction content, with full instruction reading under existing sandbox and policy controls. It does not install marketplace skills or expand permissions (#158089, #158090, #158091, #160538) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Condition scripts can skip quiet automation checks and use explicitly permitted MCP servers. Scripts and event triggers are enabled by default unless cron.triggers.enabled is set to false (#101195, #160995) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Eligible failing conversation-owned automations can request repair in their owner conversation before their first chat alert; later failures still alert. Setting failureAlert: false disables both repair requests and alerts (#161007) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Control UI sessions gain emoji reactions without starting an agent turn, plus sidebar snooze/wake controls. Snoozing parks navigation; it does not suspend ongoing work (#161053, #161960).
  • Opt-in immutable installation adoption can prepare sealed generations and explicitly activate or recover them on supported root-managed Linux installations with cgroup v2 and compatible launcher/schema support. --no-restart remains preparation-only; existing installations are not converted automatically (#163799, #164306).
  • Existing agents can be migrated to local Claws with the explicit, consented openclaw claws migrate <agent-id> workflow, preserving their workspace and sessions. Migration is not automatic (#162329) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Memory-plugin pre-compaction flushes can use plugin-owned persistence tools and read-only lookups; the default Memory Core behavior is unchanged (#162177) Thanks @jalehman.
  • GitHub Enterprise repository preparation requires matching-host credentials; worker-side gh CLI authentication remains a separate setup requirement (#160108) Thanks @galiniliev.

Plugin SDK migration

  • Breaking change: third-party plugins importing retired compatibility facades or whole-session-store helpers must migrate before upgrading. Use focused channel/config/session APIs and row-level session operations; bundled callers are migrated, but external-plugin compatibility is not assumed. See SDK migration guidance (#162220, #162333, #163366).
  • Awaited session persistence APIs commit through the writer. Deprecated synchronous adapters remain until the next major with warnings; this addition does not require a data conversion (#163264).

Fixes

  • Session continuity: preserve usage during registry changes, deliver remote-worker attachments, keep queued cancellations from stalling active turns, and apply turn timeouts through transcript aliases (#164217, #164219, #164230, #164289) Thanks @vincentkoc and @RomneyDa.
  • Paired nodes and plugin policy: align continuation signatures and apply before_agent_run policy to node turns, with lifecycle fences for queued plugin work (#164287, #164270, #164247) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Memory and transcript persistence: bound embedding-cache migrations and report oversized rows, reduce transcript-copy overhead, and move lifecycle writes off the main thread (#164303, #164251, #163815).
  • Replies and media: render supported local videos inline with actionable rejected-link errors, suppress preview cards on Telegram progress messages, and keep speech-only replies working alongside reasoning (#164137, #163727, #164285) Thanks @ivan-magda, @obviyus, and @Twilight-Networks.
  • Update and Doctor recovery: surface recorded serving verdicts, repair installations with read-only managed configuration, distinguish a still-starting Gateway from failure, and keep cleanup output from corrupting JSON results (#164193, #164235, #164261, #164312) Thanks @DonnieFi, @JD8855122, and @waynegault.
  • Already-current updates retain and apply the legacy config repair plan, including no-op updates without an explicit channel change. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Doctor and command shutdown: keep maintenance available under shared-lease liveness rules and report schema/manifest outcomes; drain lifecycle workers and shared state on CLI exit, preserving successful command results when overdue plugin cleanup produces a warning (#164697, #164853, #164915).
  • Install/update responsiveness: avoid repeated configuration reads, duplicate backups for shared database profiles, serial metadata waits, and unnecessary pnpm-root probes; successful cleanup progress no longer appears as an error (#164182, #164186, #164183, #164184, #163477) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Windows and browser startup: handle empty and nested Windows worktrees, redirected Linux Chromium caches, and automatic Playwright Chromium startup on ARM64 (#164202, #164249, #163510, #163281) Thanks @ly85206559, @obviyus, and @jesse-merhi.
  • Cloud workers and Crabbox: retain real failure causes, correct Linux lease handling, overlap bundle downloads, avoid unrelated warm-image cleanup waits, and prevent slow reads or unsupported backends from stranding workers (#164129, #164187, #164128, #164231).
  • Plugins and provider execution: capture package imports under Bun, reuse prerelease metadata, and avoid treating expired remote-execution approval as an authentication-profile failure (#164223, #164185, #164237).
  • MCP Apps: keep forms, file handoffs, and context synchronization working across app interactions (#164277).
  • Session views and model status: reuse prepared session facts and cards, keep canonical state handles, and resolve agent-local model aliases in status output (#164218, #164301, #164110, #164126) Thanks @ooiuuii and @obviyus.

item.content:encoded:
2026.10.1-beta.1

Changes since 2026.9.8, the version selected by the npm beta channel before this release. Already-shipped contributions from that stable release are excluded from the record below.

Highlights

  • Code Mode can keep small session-scoped values across cells, replies, and Gateway restarts with store and load (#164086).
  • Control UI adds click-to-play YouTube cards, nested Workboards in the sidebar, and automatic pinning for boards you create (#164576, #164604).
  • Import readable coding-agent transcripts into durable OpenClaw sessions, with private drafts by default and incremental reimport (#161955).
  • Configure off-machine backups to external disks, NAS storage, or Cloudflare R2, with visible backup health and results (#161913).
  • Automations can check conditions without a model run, call explicitly allowed MCP servers, and expose cross-job history and inventory search (#101195, #160995, #148947, #150097) Thanks @obviyus and @Alix-007.
  • Installed-skill search and reading make admitted skills discoverable even when their instructions do not fit the initial prompt budget (#158089, #158090, #158091, #160538) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Selected memory plugins can own their pre-compaction flush, preserving memory through their own persistence tools (#162177) Thanks @jalehman.
  • Cloud-worker preparation supports configured GitHub Enterprise hosts for repository discovery and prepared workflows (#160108) Thanks @galiniliev.

Changes

  • Code Mode persistence is scoped to interactive sessions, limited to 256 KiB per value and 1 MiB per session; failed cells do not commit their pending writes (#164086).
  • MCP Apps can request permission to call a specific tool while their view remains open. The grant is tied to that view and requester, expires after ten minutes or view closure, and is not a persistent model-tool allowlist (#164496).
  • YouTube cards retain a watch-link fallback; sandboxed chat views remain link-only (#164576).
  • Transcript import supports readable Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, and OpenClaw catalogs through the CLI and Control UI. Reimport appends new items, and incomplete or bounded history reads are reported (#161955).
  • Backup storage locations require configuration and explicit initialization; scheduled backups can target external disks/NAS or Cloudflare R2. Client-side encryption is available, with an explicit operator option to disable it (#161913).
  • Installed-skill search covers names, descriptions, and instruction content, with full instruction reading under existing sandbox and policy controls. It does not install marketplace skills or expand permissions (#158089, #158090, #158091, #160538) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Condition scripts can skip quiet automation checks and use explicitly permitted MCP servers. Scripts and event triggers are enabled by default unless cron.triggers.enabled is set to false (#101195, #160995) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Eligible failing conversation-owned automations can request repair in their owner conversation before their first chat alert; later failures still alert. Setting failureAlert: false disables both repair requests and alerts (#161007) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Control UI sessions gain emoji reactions without starting an agent turn, plus sidebar snooze/wake controls. Snoozing parks navigation; it does not suspend ongoing work (#161053, #161960).
  • Opt-in immutable installation adoption can prepare sealed generations and explicitly activate or recover them on supported root-managed Linux installations with cgroup v2 and compatible launcher/schema support. --no-restart remains preparation-only; existing installations are not converted automatically (#163799, #164306).
  • Existing agents can be migrated to local Claws with the explicit, consented openclaw claws migrate <agent-id> workflow, preserving their workspace and sessions. Migration is not automatic (#162329) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Memory-plugin pre-compaction flushes can use plugin-owned persistence tools and read-only lookups; the default Memory Core behavior is unchanged (#162177) Thanks @jalehman.
  • GitHub Enterprise repository preparation requires matching-host credentials; worker-side gh CLI authentication remains a separate setup requirement (#160108) Thanks @galiniliev.

Plugin SDK migration

  • Breaking change: third-party plugins importing retired compatibility facades or whole-session-store helpers must migrate before upgrading. Use focused channel/config/session APIs and row-level session operations; bundled callers are migrated, but external-plugin compatibility is not assumed. See SDK migration guidance (#162220, #162333, #163366).
  • Awaited session persistence APIs commit through the writer. Deprecated synchronous adapters remain until the next major with warnings; this addition does not require a data conversion (#163264).

Fixes

  • Session continuity: preserve usage during registry changes, deliver remote-worker attachments, keep queued cancellations from stalling active turns, and apply turn timeouts through transcript aliases (#164217, #164219, #164230, #164289) Thanks @vincentkoc and @RomneyDa.
  • Paired nodes and plugin policy: align continuation signatures and apply before_agent_run policy to node turns, with lifecycle fences for queued plugin work (#164287, #164270, #164247) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Memory and transcript persistence: bound embedding-cache migrations and report oversized rows, reduce transcript-copy overhead, and move lifecycle writes off the main thread (#164303, #164251, #163815).
  • Replies and media: render supported local videos inline with actionable rejected-link errors, suppress preview cards on Telegram progress messages, and keep speech-only replies working alongside reasoning (#164137, #163727, #164285) Thanks @ivan-magda, @obviyus, and @Twilight-Networks.
  • Update and Doctor recovery: surface recorded serving verdicts, repair installations with read-only managed configuration, distinguish a still-starting Gateway from failure, and keep cleanup output from corrupting JSON results (#164193, #164235, #164261, #164312) Thanks @DonnieFi, @JD8855122, and @waynegault.
  • Already-current updates retain and apply the legacy config repair plan, including no-op updates without an explicit channel change. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Doctor and command shutdown: keep maintenance available under shared-lease liveness rules and report schema/manifest outcomes; drain lifecycle workers and shared state on CLI exit, preserving successful command results when overdue plugin cleanup produces a warning (#164697, #164853, #164915).
  • Install/update responsiveness: avoid repeated configuration reads, duplicate backups for shared database profiles, serial metadata waits, and unnecessary pnpm-root probes; successful cleanup progress no longer appears as an error (#164182, #164186, #164183, #164184, #163477) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Windows and browser startup: handle empty and nested Windows worktrees, redirected Linux Chromium caches, and automatic Playwright Chromium startup on ARM64 (#164202, #164249, #163510, #163281) Thanks @ly85206559, @obviyus, and @jesse-merhi.
  • Cloud workers and Crabbox: retain real failure causes, correct Linux lease handling, overlap bundle downloads, avoid unrelated warm-image cleanup waits, and prevent slow reads or unsupported backends from stranding workers (#164129, #164187, #164128, #164231).
  • Plugins and provider execution: capture package imports under Bun, reuse prerelease metadata, and avoid treating expired remote-execution approval as an authentication-profile failure (#164223, #164185, #164237).
  • MCP Apps: keep forms, file handoffs, and context synchronization working across app interactions (#164277).
  • Session views and model status: reuse prepared session facts and cards, keep canonical state handles, and resolve agent-local model aliases in status output (#164218, #164301, #164110, #164126) Thanks @ooiuuii and @obviyus.

Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete 842697352d230da72571fdbf06440c325e7cc34c..6830fe76b3db05ad59e8ff7f0f872d4e2639a1fe history: 2,403 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 2,403 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

item.title: openclaw 2026.8.35
item.description:
This is a gateway-only extended-stable release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of August 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is 2026.9.7

2026.8.35

Highlights

  • GPT-6.1 Sol support: add the current Sol model across OpenAI routing, discovery, reasoning, harness, and Reef guard-model boundaries. (#161400, #162955)
  • Safer updates and recovery: preserve plugin settings, prevent duplicate Gateways, handle pnpm package updates without terminal failures, and retain plugin inventory through migration. (#160344, #160193, #161920, #161485) Thanks @EndeavorPioneer, @grtninja, @alkor2000, @xilopaint, and @aniruddhaadak80.
  • Reliable agent completion: preserve complete delegated and CLI answers, release suspended child capacity, recover full cron output, and prevent failed requests from consuming steered questions. (#162843, #162368, #160520, #162439) Thanks @zyz619963502zyz, @holgergruenhagen, @armstrongsam25, @davidcittadini, @jayzhou2309, and @obviyus.
  • Security and ownership hardening: keep secret-store kinds stable during rotation, restore admitted secret-egress execution, and retain explicit cron tool allowlists while repairing stale automatic snapshots. (#160926, #160760, #162432) Thanks @zachisfine, @yetval, @VACInc, and @obviyus.
  • Channel and integration reliability: repair Gmail and IMAP watchers, Matrix direct mappings, Telegram progress, remote MCP startup, and managed llama.cpp startup on clean Windows hosts. (#161503, #160413, #161727, #161546, #162376, #163093) Thanks @obviyus, @kazuyuki-eguchi, @Ayushdevo, @addyCooks, @VACInc, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @RomneyDa.
  • Performance and UI continuity: bound model-catalog waits, reduce Codex fleet heap pressure, and keep saved WebChat replies visible across history refresh races. (#161132, #162912, #162763) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @Flakedict, @obviyus, @609NFT, and @VACInc.

Changes

  • Extended-stable release preparation: align OpenClaw and every publishable official plugin to 2026.8.35 while preserving the 2026.8.34 publication contract.
  • Model compatibility: add GPT-6.1 Sol to the branch-native OpenAI and Reef compatibility owners. (#161400, #162955)

Fixes

  • Update safety: preserve incompatible-plugin settings through recovery, keep retained plugin records during migration, avoid pnpm terminal failures, and carry the existing Gateway lock through container/direct startup. (#160344, #161485, #161920, #160193) Thanks @EndeavorPioneer, @aniruddhaadak80, @alkor2000, @xilopaint, and @grtninja.
  • Agent delivery: recover uncapped cron replies, preserve complete CLI subagent answers, honor skipped announcements, retain detached transcripts, release suspended child slots, and keep failed requests from replacing earlier questions with a steer. (#160520, #162843, #161542, #161091, #162368, #162439) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @zyz619963502zyz, @holgergruenhagen, @armstrongsam25, @davidcittadini, and @obviyus.
  • Cron and tools: bound thinking-catalog hydration, repair stale automatic tool snapshots without widening explicit allowlists, and deliver manual runs after their creating turn ends. (#161132, #162432, #162780) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @Flakedict, and @obviyus.
  • Sessions and tool results: reject malformed session targets, preserve spawned working directories, project deeply nested MCP results safely, and keep remote MCP bundles working in native sessions. (#161533, #162308, #160825, #162376) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @Takhoffman, @hpyhandsome, and @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Channels: recover Gmail transient binds, bound IMAP backlog processing, restore Matrix direct mappings, and restore Telegram progress when hooks suppress previews. (#161503, #160413, #161727, #161546) Thanks @obviyus, @kazuyuki-eguchi, @Ayushdevo, @addyCooks, and @VACInc.
  • Runtime reliability: prevent redaction stalls, cancel stale thinking-catalog waits, pass the responding agent to TTS model selection, stop durable worker retries from freezing hosts, reduce Codex fleet heap use, and install the required Visual C++ runtime after a managed llama.cpp launch failure. (#161089, #161319, #161454, #160812, #162912, #163093) Thanks @Baumus, @drakeo338, @aounakram, @RileyJJY, @aniruddhaadak80, @obviyus, @609NFT, and @RomneyDa.
  • Secrets and sandboxing: retain secret entry kinds during value rotation and repair read-only copied skills without escaping their confined roots. (#160926, #162304, #162295) Thanks @zachisfine and @yetval.
  • WebChat: keep saved replies visible when stale history responses race with live messages. (#162763) Thanks @VACInc.

Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.8.34..741d94f386d24b269cce748863ebd6c94d0e1b01 history: 49 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 49 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

item.title: openclaw 2026.8.34
item.description:
This is a gateway-only extended-stable release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of August 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is 2026.9.7

2026.8.34

Highlights

  • Extended-stable correctness rollup: backport 113 audit-selected fix units across upgrades, Doctor, authentication, sessions, channels, plugins, sandboxing, filesystem safety, model runtimes, and release packaging.
  • Complete rescan: re-evaluate the full 2026.8.33 discovery range, large mixed-purpose pull requests, and the 2026.7.35 lineage instead of advancing only from the previous backport cursor.
  • Upgrade and recovery hardening: preserve credentials, agent state, plugin inventory, transcripts, schedules, service ownership, and runtime links through upgrades, restarts, and Doctor repair.
  • Boundary fixes: tighten remote filesystem mutation, plugin and skill scanning, browser authentication, channel reply identity, private skill ingress, and scoped runtime ownership.

Changes

  • Extended-stable release preparation: align OpenClaw, publishable plugins, native version metadata, generated channel catalogs, and npm package inventories to 2026.8.34.

Fixes

  • Plugins: Recover orphan installs without weakening ownership.
  • Doctor: Repair keyed multi-agent rosters without ownership (#134706)
  • Prevent device pairing migration crash on contaminated records.
  • Doctor: Preserve per-agent memory search during upgrades.
  • Doctor: Detect shared auth migration by provenance (#134808)
  • Cron: Refuse stale doctor store rewrites.
  • Gateway: Refresh model catalog after auth changes (#134361)
  • Openai: Repair stale doctor route pins.
  • Auth: Verify shared credential migration receipts (#134952)
  • Cron: Keep model aliases scoped to the selected owner (#135069)
  • Memory: Resolve profile auth for compatible embeddings (#134744)
  • Auth: Recover credentials stranded by completed migrations (#135346)
  • Auth: Relogin repairs stale profile order after upgrade.
  • Auth: Preserve custom provider SecretRefs in Doctor.
  • Docker: Install libgomp1 in the runtime image for managed llama.cpp (#134532)
  • Devices: Allow authorized scoped node token management (#135617)
  • Msteams: Thread context is dropped when a channel reply has no replyToId (#129345)
  • Ui: Ignore tool-only model auth rows (#134218)
  • Cron: Kind change fails with "command env must be an object" when env is omitted (#134639)
  • Backup: Exclude workspaces before traversal.
  • Infra: Drop empty PATHEXT entries from Windows extension lookup (#135807)
  • Anthropic: Context usage is lost when a proxy omits message_delta usage (#135467)
  • Systemd: Protect credentials in managed backups (#131786)
  • Agents: Preserve requester MCP runtime ownership (#134819)
  • Plugins: Refresh persisted registry when source mounts change (#136517)
  • Gateway restart hangs while followup drain retries a draining error (#136713)
  • Auth: Preserve OAuth metadata during session SDK refresh (#127988)
  • Doctor: Recognize configured memory provider secret references (#137782)
  • Sessions: Preserve logical shared-store ownership (#138380)
  • Full-access tasks lose tools after Gateway restart (#138701)
  • Keep unchanged files out of session diffs (#138877)
  • Auth: Recover billing-disabled profiles in minutes instead of hours (#136364)
  • Auth: Keep an unset default model unchanged during login (#139218)
  • Gateway: Avoid crashes when an upgrading client disconnects (#139061)
  • Shell-env: Preserve CLI terminal ownership during login imports (#139308)
  • Auto-reply: Fold trailing transcript growth into memory-flush fresh totals (#138928)
  • Cron: Preserve pending paced checks across restart (#140083)
  • Daemon: Systemd install no longer aborts on "ownership could not be verified" after a clock step (#137253)
  • Config: Apply environment changes after in-process restart (#141296)
  • Pasted text is missing in model-locked Codex sessions (#142021)
  • Docker: Restore source builds after dependency ownership guard (#142073)
  • Security: Preserve existing WhatsApp group allowlists (#142589)
  • Doctor: Avoid installing unselected search providers (#142640)
  • Doctor: Migrate legacy Codex music model selectors (#143235)

  • Retain route ownership while discovering conversations (#146927)

  • Doctor: Stop private pending inputs replaying after session repair (#148625)
  • Channels: Settle task-scoped context leases once (#148922)
  • Push: Normalize malformed proxy auth errors (#149112)
  • Cron: Reject invalid stagger before silent schedule changes (#151740)
  • Cli: Keep model validation out of session execution (#154763)
  • Agents: Treat empty credential environment variables as unresolved (#155558)
  • Doctor: Apply ambient-owner fallback to dream diary and all memory target handlers (#156437)
  • Sandbox: Unblock scoped recreation across runtime targets (#157808)
  • Security: Parse gpt generation numbers in the audit tier check (#140012)
  • Doctor: Report shared auth health without a default agent (#134902)
  • Doctor: Converge redundant shared auth relocation subsets (#135096)
  • Doctor: Report retained device-auth files (#133978)

  • Gateway: Recover queued RPC replies across restart (#138565)

  • Prevent browser profile permission hangs in Doctor (#139612)
  • Gateway: Prevent systemd restarts from hanging (#140914)

  • Skills: Refresh session snapshots on gateway restart (#122110)
  • Doctor: Session SQLite import drops Codex assistant messages from legacy transcripts (#140296)
  • Cron: Forward claude-cli auth profile on scheduled runs to prevent OAuth expiration (#144266)
  • Discord: Preserve sender-owned line limits and reply scope (#137969)
  • Install: Never replace or break an existing nvm during installation (#145317)
  • Sessions: Recover omitted historical transcripts in Doctor (#120781)
  • Update: Recognize custom npm prefix installations (#146091)
  • Context: Preserve provider-scoped prompt budgets before reply maintenance (#141052)
  • Sessions: Prevent Doctor and startup memory exhaustion (#149704)
  • Daemon: Preserve inline auth through service upgrades (#149686)
  • Update: Verify paired trusted-proxy gateways with service credentials (#153540)
  • Background continuations lose session access and GitHub tools (#141865)
  • Doctor: Decode session headers across read chunk boundaries (#154034)
  • Faulty compaction probe wedges run steering and restart aborts (#154868)
  • Ui: Publish rejected goal operations (#156363)
  • Commands: Deduplicate session lifecycle keys (#158487)
  • Plugins: Preserve runtime artifact preference (#158487)
  • Agents: Strip private skill authoring from public ingress (#159220)
  • Plugins: Preserve include ownership during uninstall (#159945)
  • Channels: Restore system-agent approval reactions (#159132)
  • Moonshot: Reject inherited thinking-model keys (#158437)
  • Tencent: Ignore inherited effort-map keys (#158437)
  • Workers: Observe already-aborted operation promises (#158228)
  • Gateway: Reject non-object Claude history rows (#158228)
  • Copilot: Recover pool after synchronous factory failures (#157819)
  • Tlon: Preserve IPv6 ship origins (#157825)
  • Sms: Clean revoked inbound media (#157825)
  • Slack: Preserve replacement webhook registrations (#158085)
  • Matrix: Accept system-agent approval reactions (#158164)
  • Channels: Retain typing tick exclusivity across restart (#158830)
  • Acp: Format unset optional tool arguments (#159417)
  • Meeting: Clean up partial audio startup (#157982)
  • Exec: Retain prepared plugin environment (#158378)
  • Mxc: Clean temp directory after bridge failure (#158532)
  • Discord: Preserve batched native reply identities (#158886)
  • Skills: Count omitted dangerous exec aliases once (#158906)
  • Sandbox: Preserve remote mutation path bytes (#159346)
  • Browser: Accept standard CDP header containers (#159430)
  • Plugins: Preserve sparse catalog preferences (#159945)
  • Doctor: Preserve complete plugin inventory (#153901)
  • Fs: Preserve bounded filesystem correctness (#157524)

Complete contribution record

This release represents 113 approved units: 60 exact source commits, 25 material adaptations, 27 narrow slices extracted from large or mixed-purpose pull requests, and one 2026.7.35 plugin-inventory parity repair. Units already covered by the 2026.8.33 architecture, or whose newer storage contract does not exist on this release line, are recorded as evidence-backed inclusions rather than duplicate or speculative code.

  • release publish: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36941737739

item.title: openclaw 2026.8.33
item.description:
This is a gateway-only extended-stable release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of August 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is 2026.9.6

2026.8.33

Highlights

  • Current flagship models: add Meta Muse Spark 1.3, Anthropic Fable 5.1, OpenAI GPT-6 Astra, and OpenAI/fal GPT Image 2.5 support to the extended-stable line. (#135638, #136553, #137550, #143068, #143069)
  • Complete GPT-5.6 family support: preserve Sol, Terra, and Luna catalog, routing, migration, image, vision, and thinking behavior, including Ultra reasoning across model-runtime boundaries and Bedrock tool-result images. (#135397, #149336)
  • Extended-stable security rollup: reconcile all repository advisories that affect 2026.8.2, harden Prometheus metrics authorization and Discord asset/voice ownership, and clear the production Nodemailer advisory gate. (#136700, #137433, #140334, #140903)

Changes

  • Extended-stable release preparation: normalize OpenClaw, all publishable plugins, and native version metadata to 2026.8.33 while retaining the release-line-compatible publication workflows from 2026.8.2.

Fixes

  • Anthropic reasoning continuity: preserve Fable 5.1 reasoning through model switches and runtime events. (#136782)
  • OpenAI discovery: require successful model discovery before offering GPT-6 Astra through OAuth. (#137561)
  • Doctor skill state: preserve explicitly enabled skills during automatic updates. (#138730)
  • Generated media: retain generated images when a later tool call fails. (#131226)
  • Matrix verification: refresh verification state before reporting device trust. (#136226)
  • Prometheus authorization: reject metric scrapes that lack the configured operator-read scope. (#140903)
  • Discord media policy: enforce sender media policy for guild asset uploads. (#140334)
  • Discord realtime ownership: preserve speaker and playback ownership across voice lifecycle transitions. (#137433)
  • Discord consult cancellation: record host-cancelled realtime consults as cancellation, suppress the generic error fallback, and keep the voice session ready for the next request. (#134924, #135380)
  • Dependency security: override the IMAP dependency graph to Nodemailer 9.1.1, clearing the address-parser denial-of-service and related domain/content-access advisories. (#136700)
  • iOS release validation: update the WebRTC binary dependency to 152.0.0 after the 151.0.0 artifact was withdrawn. (#134942)

item.title: openclaw 2026.7.35
item.description:
This is a gateway-only extended-stable release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of July 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is 2026.9.5

2026.7.35

Fixes

  • Doctor plugin registry: preserve the complete bundled plugin inventory when Doctor creates or repairs registry state, so default Browser, Canvas, pairing, file-transfer, phone-control, Talk voice, and Bonjour plugins remain available after restart. State-migration discovery now also recovers from the partial registry written by 2026.7.34 while retaining external plugin install records. Backported from #136045. Thanks @wangmiao0668000666.

Complete contribution record

This extended-stable follow-up was selected from a complete 1,418-commit audit after the prior 2026.7.34 audit cursor. No other defect observed during clean install or the 2026.6.35 upgrade required a July-line backport.

Cumulative July extended-stable notes

OpenClaw 2026.7.33 and 2026.7.34 were unstable extended-stable builds and were intentionally not published as GitHub Releases. Because 2026.7.35 is the first GitHub Release for the July maintenance line, it includes their complete changelogs below.

2026.7.33

Highlights

  • Security and credential safety: harden command parsing, browser origin checks, plugin Git installs, diagnostics, service credentials, and webhook logging across Gateway and official plugins.
  • Message and session integrity: preserve queued, imported, streamed, and tool-result messages across retries, hooks, recovery, and channel lifecycle transitions.
  • Gateway reliability: close failed HTTP and Responses streams, bound expensive reads and history queries, and settle shutdown work before reporting completion. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Channel delivery: repair Discord, Matrix, Telegram, Slack, WhatsApp, LINE, Feishu, Zalo, and meeting-plugin edge cases that could lose, corrupt, or stall messages.
  • Provider and media robustness: bound provider requests and diagnostics, reject malformed payloads, and preserve valid tool schemas and response lifecycles. Thanks @RomneyDa.

Changes

  • Extended-stable release tooling: carry the current Docker channel classifier, promoter, verification policy, and tests so v2026.7.33 can move only the extended-stable* aliases. Thanks @RomneyDa.

Fixes

  • Security boundaries: reject escaped-newline command words, exact-origin mismatches, injected Git option arguments, inherited secret-response identifiers, unsafe browser mutations, and malformed or oversized node payloads.
  • Delivery and transcript recovery: keep retry delays accurate, preserve imported messages and plugin-blocked tool results, retain detached admissions, and avoid silently dropping channel actions or recovery work. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Resource and lifecycle safety: bound catalog, history, media, stderr, API, and provider waits; stop canceled parallel tools; drain channel shutdown; and reject queued worker requests after close. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Text and schema correctness: preserve UTF-16 boundaries across user-visible truncation paths, keep root tool-schema properties, reject non-finite schema values, and report exact UTF-8 write sizes.
  • Official plugins: repair message parsing, proxy paths, request timeouts, media handling, privacy-safe logging, and runtime aliases across the npm-published plugin inventory.

Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.7.1-2..42625327f91254cfe66cbeb6d7a1812780b1a694 history: 126 merged PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

Pull requests

  • PR #102438 fix: auth bookkeeping no longer reverts rotated OpenAI OAuth credentials. Related #102430. Thanks @obviyus.
  • PR #102125 fix(gateway): finish plugin HTTP responses after post-header failures. Thanks @mushuiyu886.
  • PR #102451 fix(memory-host): reject queued worker requests on shutdown. Thanks @QiuYuang.
  • PR #102276 fix(agent-core): stop canceled parallel tools from starting. Related #102252. Thanks @harjothkhara and @yetval.
  • PR #101739 fix(secrets): reject inherited exec response ids. Thanks @Alix-007.
  • PR #102089 fix(twilio): redact webhook turnToken diagnostics. Thanks @Alix-007.
  • PR #102403 fix(backup): write backup archive with owner-only 0o600 permissions. Thanks @yetval.
  • PR #102398 fix(plugins): terminate git clone args so git: specs cannot inject options. Thanks @yetval.
  • PR #38290 Gateway: allow extension origins in browser allowlist. Related #46520. Thanks @brunowowk and @mosidevv.
  • PR #102013 fix(gateway): bound sessions.usage all-agent session discovery concurrency. Thanks @masatohoshino.
  • PR #102825 fix(gateway): parse image data URLs linearly. Related #102393. Thanks @wangyan2026 and @yetval.
  • PR #102426 fix: redact diagnostic config fields with schema hints [AI]. Thanks @pgondhi987.
  • PR #101000 fix(plugins): bound hosted catalog feed reads on non-streaming responses. Thanks @hugenshen and @cursoragent.
  • PR #104625 fix(gateway): demote startup close transport races.
  • PR #104540 fix(sessions): prevent corrupted Unicode in persisted tool details. Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt.
  • PR #104734 fix(models): redact synthetic auth credentials from models status --json. Related #104713. Thanks @ObliviateRickLin and @davefano.
  • PR #104811 fix(gateway): keep channels stopped during shutdown and reload. Thanks @ShiroKSH.
  • PR #102881 fix(gateway): reject disallowed browser Origin before accepting auth.mode=none on HTTP (#102834). Thanks @wangyan2026 and @yetval.
  • PR #101469 fix(hooks): bound HOOK.md reads during hook install validation. Thanks @cxbAsDev.

  • PR #102484 fix(gateway): keep live chat assistant buffer tail truncation UTF-16 safe. Thanks @wings1029.
  • PR #102477 fix(talk): use truncateUtf16Safe for LLM-prompt-facing text truncation. Thanks @xydt-tanshanshan.

  • PR #102500 fix(mcp-runtime): use truncateUtf16Safe for MCP metadata text truncation. Thanks @lsr911.
  • PR #102515 fix(compaction): use truncateUtf16Safe for post-compaction context text. Thanks @lsr911.
  • PR #102525 fix(discord): use truncateUtf16Safe for deploy error body truncation. Thanks @lsr911.
  • PR #102527 fix(oc-path): use truncateUtf16Safe for error message path truncation. Thanks @lsr911.
  • PR #102536 fix(nodes): restore Mac app allowlist execution. Related #102528.
  • PR #102149 fix(google-meet): bound Meet v2 + Drive files.export request deadlines. Thanks @wangmiao0668000666.
  • PR #102524 fix(memory-core): use truncateUtf16Safe for diary context truncation. Thanks @lsr911.
  • PR #102389 fix(web-fetch): report exact-limit response bodies as complete, not truncated [AI-assisted]. Related #101837. Thanks @Supsumintong and @qingminglong.
  • PR #101832 fix: keep Gemini thinking disabled after clamp. Related #101785. Thanks @MonkeyLeeT and @aniruddhaadak80.
  • PR #104049 fix: installer removes temporary files after failed commands.

  • PR #102859 fix(nextcloud-talk): add timeout to room info lookup. Thanks @Alix-007 and @Leon-SK668.

  • PR #103547 fix(voice-call): redact phone numbers in event logs via subsystem logger. Thanks @xialonglee.

  • PR #97024 fix(session-delivery): propagate non-ENOENT retry persistence failures. Thanks @0xghost42.
  • PR #114076 fix: debug proxy respects response backpressure (issue #105701). Thanks @qingminglong and @aniruddhaadak80.
  • PR #128799 fix(ai): preserve root properties when flattening root-level anyOf tool schemas. Related #128743. Thanks @LiuwqGit and @Patrick-Erichsen and @schaba21.
  • PR #131546 fix(copilot): own BYOK response stream lifecycles. Related #131544.

2026.7.34

Highlights

  • Current model families: add GPT-6 Astra, GPT Image 2.5 Flare/Sunburst, Muse Spark 1.3, Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.6/3.7 Flash, Grok 4.6, Kimi K3, GLM 5.3, Qwen 3.8, DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Experimental, and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning support across the provider catalogs and runtime policies that ship on extended stable. Fable 5.1 remains deferred because its prefix-bound reasoning contract requires the newer append-only replay lifecycle.
  • GPT-5.6 compatibility: retain and verify the complete GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna family across direct OpenAI and Codex OAuth routing, reasoning controls, pricing, context, and vision metadata.

Fixes

  • Installer recovery: preserve the original npm recovery diagnostics when an install repair attempt also fails, so operators see the actionable package-manager error instead of a secondary cleanup failure.

Complete contribution record

This extended-stable candidate was selected from a complete 11,198-commit audit after v2026.7.33. It adapts the approved provider and installer slices to the 7.33 SDK and configuration surface without importing later architectural refactors.
